company.name: Eighty6
company.shortDescription: Eighty6 is a SaaS, B2B Sales and Ordering solution for the HORECA Distributors
company.description:
Eighty6 is a cutting-edge SaaS platform, specializing in B2B FoodTech solutions. Our mission is to revolutionize the way businesses in the food industry manage their procurement and sales processes. By leveraging advanced AI technology, Eighty6 aims to streamline and digitize these critical operations, bringing efficiency, transparency, and innovation to the forefront.

Key Features:

1.	AI-Driven Procurement:
•	Harness the power of AI to optimize procurement processes.
•	Intelligent demand forecasting for better inventory management.
2.	Smart Sales Solutions:
•	AI-assisted sales strategies for personalized and effective transactions.
•	Predictive analytics to identify potential sales opportunities.
3.	Enhanced Supply Chain Management:
•	AI-powered insights for proactive supply chain optimization.
•	Adaptive logistics for real-time adjustments.
4.	Data-Driven Decision-Making:
•	Real-time analytics and reporting for actionable insights.
•	Historical data analysis for strategic planning.
5.	Customized AI Solutions:
•	Tailor AI functionalities to meet the specific needs of your business.
•	Continuous learning algorithms for adaptive performance

Facilitate digital transactions for seamless sales operations.

Real-time Data Insights:
